newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Reformer Chubais named Russian finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Reformer Chubais named Russian finance minister.

text.p: First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais, a reformer, will also be finance minister in the new Russian government, Interfax news agency quoted Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin as saying on Monday.
Chubais, shifted to the government from the post of the head of the Kremlin administration on March 7, is expected to take overall charge of economic reforms.
As finance minister he replaces Alexander Livshits, also a reformer.

Chubais was one of an initial group of ministers named by Chernomyrdin under a reshuffle ordered by President Boris Yeltsin. The names of the others were expected to be announced later on Monday or on Tuesday.
